details:
This update for nodejs24 fixes the following issues:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-105481: Keep-alive socket process a response that was written before the request was sent (bsc#1286565).
- CVE-2026-105482: dns.resolve truncates names containing NUL char (bsc#1286561).
- CVE-2026-105483: TLS certificate hostname bypass when the IP is written fullwidth digits (bsc#1286562).
- CVE-2026-106069: TLS certificate hostname bypass when the host loosely resolves to an IP address (bsc#1286563).
- CVE-2026-106072: Improper certificate validation for non-canonical IPv4 hostnames allows DNS SANs to authenticate IP
  endpoints (bsc#1286566).
- CVE-2026-106073: Permission Model bypass with fs.realpathSync (bsc#1286570).
- CVE-2026-106074: crypto.randomUUID() and randomInt() entropy caches are saved into user-land startup snapshots and
  SEAs, so every process repeats the same values (bsc#1286567).
- CVE-2026-111497: Node.js Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write permits remote code execution (bsc#1286564).

Non security issue fixed:

- "npm install -h" output is truncated (bsc#1276224).

Changes for nodejs24:

Update to 24.22.1:

 - crypto: update root certificates to NSS 3.131.1
 - deps: update c-ares to 1.34.9
 - deps: update timezone to 2026e
 - deps: upgrade openssl sources to openssl-3.5.9
 - deps: update undici to 7.30.1

Update to 24.22.0:

 - crypto: add crypto.parsePKCS12()
 - crypto: discover ciphers and hashes from OpenSSL providers
 - crypto: enable SIV and GCM-SIV modes in Cipher/Decipher APIs
 - doc: deprecate Server.prototype._listen2 in node:net
 - net: support sending net.BoundSocket to threads and child processes
 - perf_hooks: implement SlidingWindowHistogram
 - perf_hooks: implement qrde analysis support in Histogram
 - perf_hooks: implement Histogram meanCI API
 - perf_hooks: add CBOR export/import for histogram exchange
 - sqlite: add StatementSync.prototype.close()
 - sqlite: add StatementSync.prototype[Symbol.dispose]()
 - src,lib: add util.markPromiseAsHandled
 - util: implement util.throttle
 - util: implement debounce
for details, see https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.22.0


Update to 24.21.0:

 - crypto: update root certificates to NSS 3.126
 - crypto: support loading private keys through STORE loaders
 - deps: update Undici to 7.29.1
 - lib,src: improve histogram implementation
 - net: improve performance of net.BlockList
 - perf_hooks: add statistical hypothesis testing to histogram
 - util: add non-throwing MIMEType.parse
for details see https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.21.0

Update to 24.20.0:

 - async_hooks: add using scopes to AsyncLocalStorage
 - buffer: add end parameter
 - doc: add MikeMcC399 as collaborator
 - lib,permission: add permission.drop
 - loader: implement package maps
 - src,permission: add --permission-audit
 - stream: add node:stream/iter implementation
 - test_runner: add context.log() and test:log event
 - test_runner: report entryFile in TestStream events
 - wasm: enable JSPI
for details see https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases#release-v24.20.0

Update to 24.19.0:

 - buffer: implement blob.textStream()
 - deps: update OpenSSL build config to support compression
 - doc: update blockList stability status to release candidate
 - doc: mark stream.compose stable
 - esm: add --experimental-import-text flag
 - fs: support caller-supplied readFile() buffers
 - http: add httpValidation option to configure header value validation
 - net: support TCP_KEEPINTVL and TCP_KEEPCNT in setKeepAlive
 - perf_hooks: sample delay per event loop iteration
 - src: allow empty --experimental-config-file
 - stream: expose ReadableStreamTee
 - tls: report negotiated TLS groups
 - tls: add certificateCompression option
For detailed changes, see https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases#release-v24.19.0
